target_invariant: Case advancement graph navigation is planned by a deterministic pure state-machine core; runtime side effects are emitted as explicit intents or contracts and applied only outside the planner boundary.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: state-machine transition tests run without Redis, adapters, Telegram, or real agents
acceptance_coverage.notes: The planner and fixture tests operate on WorkflowDefinition and Case-shaped inputs only.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: existing eEPC state-machine regression remains covered
acceptance_coverage.notes: The broader runtime regression remains the compatibility check for create/deploy/run behavior after planner extraction.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: transition outputs are deterministic for the same workflow, case, and payload
acceptance_coverage.notes: Branch selection, joins, waits, terminals, loops, and malformed graphs are encoded as repeatable planner fixtures.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: side effects are emitted as commands or intents, not executed inline by transition logic
acceptance_coverage.notes: advanceCase applies planner results through work-item, wait/subscription, outbox, adapter, subprocess, and cleanup boundaries.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: gateway split and join handling use one shared planner path
acceptance_coverage.notes: AND/OR splits, branch work-item planning, and join pass-through/reachability are planned in transition-planner.ts before runtime application.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: advancement module is reduced to runtime application of planned transitions and effect boundaries
acceptance_coverage.notes: Graph navigation and subprocess effect construction are outside advancement.ts; advancement.ts persists state and applies side-effect boundaries.

side_effect_boundaries.boundary: event wait, subscription, and reminder scheduling

closure_decision.notes: This reconciles the #680 parent after #725, #726, #727, and #728. Production release still follows the #686 checklist and #812 terminal-case gate.
